rows.name: Vault: V6 challenge nonce single-use removed
P0.3: V3 in-transaction record hook not called
examples: P0.3-crash: a crash right after the payment commit must not leave the challenge reusable or the payment without evidence
P0.3-race: two Vault workers interleaving on one database admit at most one payment per challenge, never a payment without evidence
P0.3-faults: a crash at every write inside the proposal leaves either nothing or the complete record
P0.3-bypass: an owner paycap that reaches the V3/V5 core without the V6 verification is refused (fail closed)

rows.name: P0.3: core reached without V6 verification accepted
examples: P0.3-bypass: an owner paycap that reaches the V3/V5 core without the V6 verification is refused (fail closed)

rows.name: HO: P0.3 challenge single use removed in the pre-check, the transaction AND the primary key
examples: P0.3-crash: a crash right after the payment commit must not leave the challenge reusable or the payment without evidence
P0.3-race: two Vault workers interleaving on one database admit at most one payment per challenge, never a payment without evidence
A-challenge: reuse with a fresh signature, expiry, forged issuer -> refused
